files.description: C-CDA/HTML Data Dictionary — 6-page PDF documenting the single-patient C-CDA export. Maps each USCDIv1 data section (allergies, medications, problems, encounters, procedures, immunizations, vital signs, lab results, clinical notes, care plans, goals, etc.) to its source within AdvancedMD and the vocabulary codes used (SNOMED, LOINC, ICD10, CPT, RxNorm).

EHR Bulk Data Export Data Dictionary — 13-page PDF documenting the SQL Server .bak export. Covers 12 tables: EHR_Allergies, EHR_Immunizations, EHR_Messages, EHR_PatientNoteDiagnosis, EHR_Problems, EHR_Prescriptions, EHR_LabResults, EHR_ResultItems, EHR_ResultSets, EHR_ResultValues, EHR_PatientNotes, EHR_WordMerge. Includes column-level descriptions, SQL JOIN examples for lab results, and detailed explanation of the clinical notes template/field structure.

Scanned Documents & Images Export Guidance — 9-page PDF with step-by-step annotated screenshots explaining the folder structure and index files for both PM and EHR document/image exports. Covers PM Documents (decrypted-pm hierarchy with PM.Export index), EHR Documents (decrypted-ehr hierarchy with EHR.docmap.Export index), and blob data CSV files.

Data Export & Retrieval Services Desk Guide — 2-page summary flyer created in Adobe InDesign. Provides a condensed overview of all single-patient and bulk export options with brief descriptions and UI navigation paths. References the same data dictionary PDFs.

Full HTML source of the registered EHI export documentation page. Contains structured descriptions of all 7 export mechanisms (4 single-patient, 3 bulk) with field-level detail for the CSV exports and links to the PDF data dictionaries.
